name: Wonderland Trail
notes: Clockwise full loop. The NPS describes the Wonderland as about 93 miles with roughly 27,000 feet each of gain and loss; this app's OSM corridor is the operational distance used for planning. Group-site variants at the same camp are intentionally not duplicated. Check current access: several northwest trailheads have been listed as inaccessible.

name: Northern Loop + Wonderland
notes: Classic northern loop using the Northern Loop Trail and the northern Wonderland segment. The NPS cites about 8,500 feet of elevation gain; mileage varies by Sunrise/Carbon access and route condition.

name: Spray Park / Mother Mountain Loop
notes: The high Spray Park alternative links Mowich Lake, Eagles Roost, Cataract Valley, Carbon River and Ipsut Creek. Mowich Lake access is currently flagged inaccessible in the source permit data; verify road and trail status before using.
